readerQuestion: How do I stop GirlfriendGPT marketing messages while keeping useful account notices?

applicableClaims.name: GirlfriendGPT Privacy Notice
applicableClaims.note: The notice describes content, account, marketing preferences and the right to access a copy of personal data. It distinguishes visitors from subscribed users.

applicableClaims.name: GirlfriendGPT Support
applicableClaims.note: Operator-published support destination linked from the website policies. No testing of support response, account settings or an export flow was performed.

illustration.alt: Identify the actual sender, Find marketing preferences, Keep the record.

editorialReview.readerAction: Identify the promotional message, update the relevant preference and keep receipts and security notices available.
editorialReview.factBasis: Primary sources and an explicitly fictional example. No product operation is claimed.
editorialReview.productionReview: The compiled Worker, all release boundaries and formal site are checked separately.
